name: Agent Sandbox hardened runtime class
description: Ensure Sandbox and SandboxTemplate resources use an approved hardened runtimeClassName to isolate untrusted workloads from the host kernel.
remediation: Set spec.podTemplate.spec.runtimeClassName on the Sandbox or SandboxTemplate to an approved hardened runtime.
test: When hardenedSandboxRuntimeClasses is nonempty, check that each Sandbox or SandboxTemplate defines an approved runtimeClassName. Missing or empty configuration disables the check.
